title: The thumb
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting, empty American highway at night, headlight glare on wet asphalt, deep navy darkness with amber and vivid yellow accents, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 1. A trucker stopped for a hitchhiker in the rain. She wasn't there. 🚛

Original fiction. Part 2 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Ray Okafor has driven two million miles. He's seen everything a highway can show you. Except her.
scenes.image: a lone semi truck on a dark rainy two-lane highway at night, headlights blazing through the downpour

scenes.narration: It was raining hard, past midnight, somewhere on a two-lane road. Wipers on high. Coffee cold in the cupholder.
scenes.image: interior of a truck cab at night in heavy rain, wipers sweeping, a tired man's face lit by the dashboard

scenes.narration: His headlights caught a little green mile marker. Forty-one. And beside it, a young woman in a yellow raincoat. Thumb out.
scenes.image: young woman in a bright yellow raincoat on a dark rainy highway shoulder, thumb out, caught in headlights

scenes.narration: Ray doesn't pick up hitchhikers. Twenty-six years, never once. But she was soaked through, and the next town was an hour away.
scenes.image: a trucker's hands gripping a large steering wheel, rain streaming down the windshield ahead

scenes.narration: He hit the brakes. Air hissing. Forty tons groaning onto the shoulder, a hundred yards past her.
scenes.image: a big rig pulled onto a wet highway shoulder at night, hazard lights blinking amber in the rain

scenes.narration: He checked the mirror. Nobody. Just the marker, glowing red in his tail lights.
scenes.image: a truck side mirror at night reflecting an empty rainy highway shoulder bathed in red tail light

scenes.narration: He climbed down into the rain with a flashlight. Walked back. Called out. Hello? You need a ride?
scenes.image: a man in a work jacket walking along a dark highway shoulder in heavy rain, flashlight beam ahead

scenes.narration: No footprints in the mud. No car. No house for miles. Just the wind, and that little green marker.
scenes.image: an empty muddy roadside at night in a flashlight beam, rain falling, darkness all around

scenes.narration: He told himself she was a reflection. A trick of a tired brain. He drove on.
scenes.image: the semi truck pulling back onto the empty highway, red tail lights shrinking into the rain

scenes.narration: At dawn, after four hours of sleep at a truck stop, he climbed back into the cab. The passenger seat was soaked. Like someone had been sitting there all night.
scenes.image: an empty truck passenger seat in grey dawn light, the fabric dark and soaked, water pooling on the floor
